title: Coin Basket

serves.summary: The child shops with a few coins for a meal, a cold day, a storm kit or a beach trip, buying what the situation needs before what is only wanted and putting things back when the coins run out, which shows needs versus wants and choosing with limited money.

request.topic: Needs and wants with a limited amount of money
request.objective: With a fixed number of coins, buy what is needed for a situation (a meal, a cold day, a storm, a hot trip) before anything that is only wanted, putting things back when the coins run out. (SS002-01-D, SS002-01-F, SS002-01-H, SS002-03-G, SS002-01-B)

problems.ask: We need lunch for the family. Use your coins to shop.
problems.goal: Bread and milk are in the basket. A lollipop may join them with the coin that is left; the toy car first leaves too few coins for both foods.

missScene.lastTry: the milk costs more coins than are left in the purse, so it stayed on the shelf

params.story: a snowy, cold day; the child is going outside

problems.ask: It is snowing and very cold outside. Shop for what you need to go out.
problems.goal: The warm coat and the mittens are in the basket. The sled first leaves too few coins for the coat.

problems.goal: Water, the flashlight and bandages are in the basket, which uses all five coins. Candy leaves too few coins for the bandages.
